roadmap.scope: R1 (phase 01): the whole store v2 migration (ADR-088) first, then choose owned repos per account, with the scan reading the saved choice through a frozen plan. R2 (phase 02): up to 3 GitHub accounts per sign-in, per-account bio checks, removal that deletes pending suggestions, and the SigningPermit minted only by claim_domain::authority::may_sign from a same-request repo-owner + bio read (ADR-089). R3 (phase 03): imported public repos with private, never-publishable suggestions, the BR-RRA-5 move, removal, purge and the per-DID scope lock. R4 (US-RRA-007, KPI-RRA-6) deferred by the user.

conventions.paradigm: ADR-007 functional: limit arithmetic, scan intent/plan/resume, visibility, account admission, import classification and moves are pure in review_domain::repo_scope; the publish rule is pure in claim_domain::authority. Routes, the scan task and adapters do I/O only. ADTs over flags (ScanIntent, AccountPlan, ImportVerdict, SigningRefusal).
conventions.test_paradigm: Acceptance: example-based HTTP against the real app binary and the real review-app.duckdb, fakes only for GitHub and the PDS (Strategy B, DISTILL). Pure core: proptest against the CORE-RRA oracles (256 cases) plus crafter-owned proptests in review-domain/claim-domain with state-delta over a declared universe; single-example unit tests only with a `// bypass:` reason. Adapters: real DuckDB and recorded GitHub fixtures, never mocked. HTTP scenarios stay single-example (wiring, not invariants).
conventions.scenario_fns: `<test target>::<fn>`: review_app_repos_and_accounts (R1), review_app_repos_and_accounts_several (R2), review_app_repos_and_accounts_imports (R3), review_app_repos_and_accounts_core (CORE-RRA properties). Each step lists every fn it activates, RED driver first. Every #[ignore] fn of the four targets maps to exactly one step. review_app_repos_and_accounts_fixture is the v1 fixture regenerator, not a DELIVER step, and stays ignored.
conventions.step_ids: Roadmap ids differ from DISTILL's by design. Every `DELIVER NN-NN` in an HTTP #[ignore] reason and every `bind with DELIVER step NN-NN` in a CORE-RRA #[ignore] reason is a DISTILL id, not a roadmap id (F8). `distill_ids` lists the DISTILL HTTP markers a step covers; CORE properties are traced by their CORE-RRA id in n_scenarios. Test files are not edited for the renumbering.
conventions.rider_classes: Each step names one RED driver. Other activations are either a secondary driver (new behaviour, RED on activation; un-ignore it, see it RED, make it green, within the same step) or a guard (expected green on activation; record a mutation RED per mutation_red_on_pass).
conventions.core_binding_red: A step that binds a CORE-RRA property first lands the production function as a signature stub with a todo!() body (the shape in the DISTILL binding table), then points the sut_* binding at it, so un-ignoring gives a panic/assertion RED, never a compile error (F6).
conventions.test_edit_allow_list: Test-file edits limited to: removing the #[ignore] of a named scenario_fn; replacing a named sut_* todo!() body in review_app_repos_and_accounts_core.rs with ONE real call plus view mapping (DWD-RRA-7 allows moving a property into crates/review-domain/tests or crates/claim-domain/tests unchanged in name and assertions). Orchestrator ruling (F1): in 02-06 only, the mechanical &SigningPermit signature change at the existing call sites in crates/review-domain/src/link_plan.rs, crates/review-domain/tests/page_contracts.rs, crates/review-domain/tests/domain_contracts.rs and tests/acceptance/review_app_core.rs (a permit minted the production way, through may_sign over test-support facts); no assertion changes; recorded in the commit message. Forbidden otherwise: assertions, oracles, strategies, universe slots, helpers, test names. tests/acceptance/support/* stays DISTILL-owned: a needed change stops the step and goes to nw-acceptance-designer. Crafter-owned tests in their own crates (adapter-review-store migration test, adapter-github contract tests, xtask synthetic-violation tests, review-domain/claim-domain unit/property tests) may be added.
conventions.test_runs: `cargo nextest run -p openlore-review-app --test <target>` for a release suite; `cargo nextest run -p openlore-review-app` runs every shipped review-app suite (186 tests at DISTILL) plus the activated scenarios. Scoped crates only, never the workspace.
conventions.done_per_step: A step is done when its scenario_fns are un-ignored and green, its release's HTTP suite and the core suite pass, and every shipped review-app suite passes (the full `cargo nextest run -p openlore-review-app`).
conventions.mutation_red_on_pass: A guard green on activation gets a recorded mutation RED: break the named rule in production code, run the guard and show it fails, revert. The broken rule, the failing scenario and the revert go in the commit message and the execution log RED phase.
conventions.migration_order: ADR-088 lands whole in 01-01, alone, with its crate migration test as the RED driver and MG-1..MG-3 against the real v1 fixture; accounts move to github_accounts in the same step so github_links is never written after v2. No route reads repo_choices, scan_run_repos or the new suggestion columns before 01-02.
conventions.permit_order: ADR-089 (claim_domain::authority::may_sign, SigningPermit, three check-arch rules) lands alone in 02-06. No earlier step changes the publish gate (plan constructors, owner check, executor); every later gate change (02-07, 03-03, 03-06) depends on 02-06 through the chain. R1 publishing keeps today's stored-status check: an accepted risk recorded in 01-02 and 02-06 (F3).
conventions.check_arch: `cargo xtask check-arch` + `cargo test -p xtask`; each new or amended rule ships a synthetic-violation test in xtask/tests.
conventions.kpi: D-RRA-D11 counters are added to the closed KpiEvent catalogue in the step whose scenarios first count them. KPI-RRA-1..7 are registered in docs/product/kpi-contracts.yaml in the last step, 03-06 (D-RRA-T4); KPI-RRA-6 is registered as deferred with R4.
conventions.wording: Page and message pins are DISTILL-owned in tests/acceptance/support/review_app/repos_and_accounts.rs (DWD-RRA-2, DWD-RRA-18). DELIVER may rename a markup pin only through the acceptance designer.

phases.name: R1 — Store v2; choose owned repos; the scan reads the saved choice through a frozen plan

steps.name: Store v2 migration keeps everything and survives interruption
steps.description: All of ADR-088 before any reader: CHECKPOINT, timestamped backup, the v1 → v2 step in one transaction (new tables, new columns, source backfill, github_links copied to github_accounts), version 2. Account reads and writes move to github_accounts. REVIEW_APP_TEST_FAULT=migrate_before_commit is honoured only in debug builds; a release build refuses it (DWD-RRA-16).

MG-3: a start cut off before COMMIT leaves v1; the next start migrates cleanly, first backup bytes unchanged. MG-1 and MG-2 pass.
A release build with REVIEW_APP_TEST_FAULT set refuses to start; check-arch fails a synthetic ungated seam read.
Verify writes github_accounts only; forget-me deletes the DID's github_accounts rows; done_per_step holds.
green: cargo nextest run -p openlore-review-app --test review_app_repos_and_accounts --test review_app_repos_and_accounts_core
steps.implementation_notes: RED driver: the store crate's migration test (U-RRA-4; each ADD COLUMN verified on DuckDB, ADR-088 Earned Trust). Secondary driver: MG-3 (the seam does not exist). Accounts: GithubAccountsRead/Write with today's one-account behaviour, moved up from R2 because ADR-088 §1 forbids writing github_links after v2. Seam parsed in config.rs beside REVIEW_APP_CLOCK_SKEW_SECS (BuildProfile), passed to the store open as data; rule modelled on the viewer fault-seam guard. New tables join the owner-table list. Never regenerate the fixture; its comment ('before DELIVER 01-16') refers to the DISTILL id. TEST PARADIGM: conventions.test_paradigm.
